# The Build Brief

> A free five-minute AI brief for people who build, delivered every weekday at 7:30 AM ET. Published by Zye.AI.

## What's in each issue
- The one thing that matters today
- 5-8 items grouped by theme: AI and models, agents, vibe coding, tech and security, each with a source link
- Try this today: one practical tip
- Fix of the day: a real bug (identifying details removed) and how it was fixed
- Fridays: shorter weekend-build edition with a gaming corner

## Key links
- [Subscribe (free)](https://buildbrief.zye.ai/#subscribe)
- [Unbroke](https://unbroke.zye.ai/): fix service for broken vibe-coded apps, from the same team
